question: What is said to be hard to obtain even by gods?
premises: sādhu sādhu mahādevi pṛṣṭaḥ aham sura durlabham
the speaker was asked by the great goddess
the matter is hard to obtain by gods
inference: The teaching or attainment discussed is hard to obtain even by gods.
plain_english: Well, well, O great goddess, I was asked; it is hard to obtain even by gods.
